script.title: THE DELIVERY TIP
script.title_quote: the rest is for the rain
script.scene_zh: 公寓門廊 · 說明小費
script.story_hook: A tip question shows up at the door.
script.intro_zh: 小費的疑問，在門口出現。
script.welcome_en: Welcome in from the rain! Today, pizza and a money puzzle.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎從雨裡回到屋簷下！今天是一張披薩和一題金錢謎題。
script.outro: Fee or tip, now you know the difference. Drive safe out there.
script.outro_zh: 費用還是小費？現在你懂差別了。外面開車小心。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat these porch lines after the audio.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著語音，重讀門廊上的這些句子。
script.char_a_description: A petite elderly woman in her seventies with short white curls, thick square glasses, a lavender raincoat over a knit cardigan, a wool scarf, and a small coin purse in hand.
script.char_b_description: A lanky young man in his early twenties with damp blond hair under a black delivery beanie, a red windbreaker with a pizza logo, dark joggers, and wet sneakers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you made it in this rain!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ, ju ˈmeɪd ɪt ɪn ðɪs ɹeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這麼大的雨你還是送到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely! The wipers couldn't keep up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹli! ðə ˈwaɪpɚz kʊdnt kiːp ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 差點就不行了！雨刷都來不及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come up the steps, don't stand in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ʌp ðə stɛps, doʊnt stænd ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 快上台階，別站在雨裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, ma'am. Here's your pepperoni pizza.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju, mæm. hɪɹz jɔːɹ ˈpɛpəˌɹoʊni ˈpitˌsɑ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您，太太。這是您的義式香腸披薩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smells amazing already. Is that a card machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛlz əˈmæzɪŋ ɔːlˈɹɛdi. ɪz ðæt ə kɑːɹd məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 聞起來已經很香了。那是刷卡機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap or insert, whichever is easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tæp ɔːɹ ɪnˈsɜːɹt, wɛtʃˈɛvɚ ɪz ˈizəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，感應或插卡，哪個方便都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, this screen says add a tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm, ðɪs skɹɪn sɛz æd ə tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 呃，這個畫面說要加小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you'd like to, no pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf jud laɪk tə, noʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 完全自願的，沒有壓力的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, my order already had a delivery fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhoʊld ˈɑn, maɪ ˈɔːɹdɚ ɔːlˈɹɛdi hæd ə dɪˈlɪvɚi ˈfi/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我點餐時已經付過外送費了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fee goes to the store, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈfi ˈɡoʊz tə ðə stɔːɹ, ˈæktʃuːəli/
dialogue.zh: 那個費用其實是給店裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the fee and the tip are different?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈfi ænd ðə tɪp ɑːɹ ˈdɪfɹənt/
dialogue.zh: 所以費用和小費是兩回事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tip comes straight to drivers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə tɪp kʌmz stɹeɪt tə ˈdɹaɪvɚz/
dialogue.zh: 對，小費是直接給送貨司機的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, nobody explained that at checkout, did they?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt ət ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt, dɪd ðeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，結帳時可沒人這樣說明過呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's confusing for a lot of people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊ, ɪts kənˈfjuːzɪŋ fɔɹ ə ˈlɑt əv ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，好多人都搞不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do people usually tip around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du ˈpipəl ˈjuːʒuəli tɪp əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡大家通常給多少小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen to twenty percent, but it's your call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin tə ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt, bʌt ɪts jɔːɹ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 百分之十五到二十，不過由您決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I just give you cash instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ dʒʌst ɡɪv ju kæʃ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 如果我直接給你現金呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash is perfect, honestly, it's immediate.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ɪz ˈpɜːɹfɪkt, ˈɑnəstli, ɪt ɪˈmidieɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現金最好啦，老實說，馬上就到手中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let me grab my purse, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi ɡɹæb maɪ pɜːɹs, wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 那我去拿皮包，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, I'll keep the box dry here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ, aɪl kip ðə bɑks dɹaɪ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我在這裡幫您擋雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a five, is that too much?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə faɪv, ɪz ðæt tuː mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這張五塊的，會不會太多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's very kind, but four is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd, bʌt fɔːɹ ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 您太客氣了，四塊就很足夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it, the rest is for the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt, ðə ɹɛst ɪz fɔɹ ðə ɹeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 都收下吧，剩的是給你淋雨的心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you sure? Thank you so much!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːɹ ju ʃʊɹ? ˈθæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太感謝了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Now, can I trouble you for the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ. naʊ, kaɪ ˈtrʌbəl ju fɔɹ ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 當然。對了，可以請你列印收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine prints it, uh… oh no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃɪn prɪnts ɪt, ʌ… ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 機器會列印，呃……噢，不會動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's wrong? Is it broken?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ɹɔːŋ? ɪz ɪt ˈbɹoʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？壞掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen froze — it does this when wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skɹin fɹoʊz — ɪt dʌz ðɪs wɛn wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕凍住了——一淋濕就會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh dear. Do you need a towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ dɪɹ. du ju nid ə ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，天呀。你需要毛巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few seconds under the light helps, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fjuː ˈsɛkəndz ˈʌndɚ ðə laɪt hɛlps, ˈæktʃuːəli/
dialogue.zh: 在燈下烘幾秒就有用，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come, sit by the heater while it warms.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm, sɪt baɪ ðə ˈhitɚ waɪl ɪt wɔːmz/
dialogue.zh: 來，坐在暖爐邊等它暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're very kind, I won't be long.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd, aɪ woʊnt bi lɔːŋ/
dialogue.zh: 您真好，我很快就會離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course. Tea while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔːɹs. ti waɪl wi wɛɪt/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。等時候要喝杯茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, no thank you, I'm on route.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, ˈnoʊ ˈθæŋk ju, aɪm ɑn ɹut/
dialogue.zh: 哈，不用了謝謝，我還在配送路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understandable. How many stops left tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstændəbəl. haʊ ˈmɛni stɑps lɛft təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。今晚還剩幾戶要送？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three more, and this is the farthest.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi mɔːɹ, ænd ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈfɑɹðəst/
dialogue.zh: 還有三家，這裡是最遠的一戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In this weather, that's real work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðɪs ˈwɛðɚ, ðæts ɹiːl wɜːɹk/
dialogue.zh: 這種天氣，真是辛苦活。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tips make it worth the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɪps meɪk ɪt wɜːɹk ðə dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 有了小費，這趟路就值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, you'll get a good review, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, jul ɡɛt ə ɡʊd ɹɪˈvjuː, tuː/
dialogue.zh: 那你也會得到一個好評的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? How do I even get one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli? haʊ du aɪ ˈivɪn ɡɛt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？評價要怎樣才會傳來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll rate five stars, it shows right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl reɪt faɪv stɑːrz, ɪt ʃoʊz ɹaɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我會給五星，評價馬上就會顯示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it reaches me, that's bonus luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt ˈɹitʃəz mi, ðæts ˈboʊnəs lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 如果能輪到我，那就是額外運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the screen's awake again, finally!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ, ðə skɹinz əˈweɪk əˈɡɛn, ˈfɪnəli/
dialogue.zh: 瞧，螢幕又活了，太好了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Printing your receipt now, one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ˈprɪntɪŋ jɔːɹ rɪˈsit naʊ, wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！現在幫您列印收據，稍候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Did you check the order, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt. dɪd ju tʃɛk ði ˈɔːɹdɚ, baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。對了，你有核對訂單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pepperoni, stuffed crust, two garlic knots, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌpɛpəˈɹoʊni, stʌfd kɹʌst, tuː ˈɡɑɹlɪk nɑts, ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 義式香腸、夾心起司餅邊、兩份蒜香麵結，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The knots arrived soggy last time, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɑts əˈɹaɪvd ˈsɑːɡi læst ˈtaɪm, ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 上次麵結送來時都濕軟了，還記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I used a paper bag for them tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juzd ə ˈpeɪpɚ bæɡ fɔɹ ðɛm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我把它們放進紙袋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clever! Card, please, let's finish this up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvɚ! kɑːɹd, pliz, lɛts ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 聰明！來刷卡吧，把這單結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap whenever you're ready. There we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp wɛnˈɛvɚ jʊɹ ˈɹɛdi. ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 準備好就感應一下。好了，成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Approved. You're all set, young man.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpɹuːvd. jʊɹ ɔl sɛt, jʌŋ mæn/
dialogue.zh: 扣款核准了。你可以出發了，年輕人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks again for the tip and the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks əˈɡɛn fɔɹ ðə tɪp ænd ðə tʃɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 再次謝謝您的小費和那張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anytime. Drive carefully out there, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm. dɹaɪv ˈkɛɹfəli aʊt ðɛr, pliz/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣。外面路滑，請慢慢開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, stay dry and enjoy dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl, steɪ dɹaɪ ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ˈdɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。請待在乾處，用餐愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll be ordering every Friday, for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl bi ˈɔːɹdɚɹɪŋ ˈɛvɹi ˈfɹaɪdeɪ, fɔːɹ ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我們會每個星期五都點，說定的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Fridays are busy, but we manage.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! ˈfɹaɪdeɪz ɑːɹ ˈbɪzi, bʌt wi ˈmænɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！星期五很忙，但我們應付得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll have the cash ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl hæv ðə kæʃ ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 下次我會先把現金準備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, honestly. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlpz ə ˈlɑt, ˈɑnəstli. ˈθæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那樣真的很有幫助。謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Now hurry, before the rain returns.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈwɛlkəm. naʊ ˈhɜːɹi, bɪˈfɔːɹ ðə ɹeɪn ɹɪˈtɜːɹnz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。快出發吧，趁雨還沒回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, and enjoy the pizza while it's hot!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈpitˌsɑ waɪlz ɪts hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，趁熱享用披薩！

script.youtube_title_en: "The Rest Is for the Rain" - Questioning the Pizza Delivery Tip
script.youtube_description:
點披薩時已經付了外送費，司機面前的畫面又跳出小費，到底給不給？這集60句沉浸式英文聽力，在一個雨夜的公寓門口把這件事說清楚。

劇情：銀髮太太收到熱騰騰的香腸披薩，刷卡機卻因淋雨當機。年輕司機解釋費用進了店家、小費才歸司機，她索性拿出現金道謝，兩人在門廊聊起雨夜跑單、蒜香麵結與五星評價。

你將學會：
- 用 Hold on, my order already had a delivery fee 提出疑問
- 用 How much do people usually tip 詢問小費行情
- 請人稍等、關心對方、慢慢道別的生活句

每句都附國際音標與繁中翻譯，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能開口用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
記得訂閱頻道、開啟小鈴鐺，每天一集沉浸式英文！
script.youtube_description_en: You already paid a delivery fee, so why does the driver's screen ask for a tip? In this 60-line immersive English listening lesson, a kind customer and a rain-soaked pizza driver clear up the confusion, fix a frozen card machine, and end the night with cash, thanks, and a promise to order again.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍕披薩外送英文｜分清費用與小費・機器淋雨重開・現金道謝｜聽完就懂給法｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
明明付過外送費，司機手中的畫面為什麼還在要小費？當面問會不會很尷尬？
這一集帶大家站到雨夜的公寓門廊，看一位銀髮太太和年輕司機把費用、小費與收據一次聊清楚。
你會聽到：
- 💳 「So the fee and the tip are different?」— 禮貌問出金錢的差別。
- 💵 「How much do people usually tip around here?」— 小費行情的自然問法。
- 🌧️ 「The screen froze — it does this when wet.」— 設備當機怎麼解釋。
- 🙏 「Keep it, the rest is for the rain.」— 溫暖又大方的道謝方式。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧，每句十詞以內，慢速清楚，讓你聽了就想跟著唸。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
下次門鈴響起，記得給雨夜裡的人一個微笑！
